newsitem.title: USA: American Coin credit facility increased.
newsitem.headline: American Coin credit facility increased.

text.p: American Coin Merchandising Inc said on Thursday it increased its multiyear revolving credit facility with Wells Fargo Bank to $9 million from $6 million.
The extension provides for the financing of American Coin's working capital requirements and the issuance of letters of credit in addition to providing capital expenditure funding.
American Coin Merchandising and its franchisees own and operate more than 8,000 coin-operated skill-crane machines throughout the U.S.
